title: context-firewall brief
description: Plan section 3. No frontier model ever sees a raw artifact; the local model reads it and emits this. Cap 2000 tokens in the harness; truncate and flag rather than passing a fat one through. Enforce with LM Studio structured-output / JSON-schema-constrained decoding so a malformed brief is impossible.

summary.description: One or two sentences. What is wrong, and the smallest true statement of scope.

first_divergence.description: path:line -- earliest point the run departs from correct behaviour, plus the mechanism in a clause.

already_ruled_out.description: Hypotheses the local attempts eliminated, so no downstream tier repeats them.

files_worth_reading.description: path:line-range only. Retrieval output, not a file dump.

question_for_escalation.description: Section 4.4: non-null ONLY when it names a DECISION the model cannot make from the code alone -- not a fact it merely does not know (that is a retrieval miss, route to T0). Null when the local tier can still make progress.
